Terms used by soilhub

Source: R/soilhub-terms.R
soilhub-terms.Rd

The words of the Global Soil Data Hub and of its sources (WoSIS, WISE, SOTER, SOTWIS) used in the arguments, the columns and the help pages of the package. The sources' own terms (in capitals) are kept as the sources write them.

Levels of the data

  • dataset: one collection of the catalog ("wosis_points", "wise_profiles", "soter_profiles", "soter_polygons", "sotwis_polygons", "sotwis_components", "sotwis_estimates"), from one provider (provider_code, e.g. "isric") and one release (release_code); see soil_datasets().

  • feature: a place, with its geometry: a profile site (a point) or a soil map unit (a polygon). Column feature_id.

  • profile: the soil described at a place (profile_id). In SOTER and SOTWIS a profile is identified by PRID.

  • component: one of the soils of a multi-component map unit (SOTER and SOTWIS polygons), covering a share of it (proportion_percent); component_id, component_rank. Point profiles have one component.

  • horizon: one layer of a profile, with an upper and a lower depth in cm (horizon_id, horizon_name, upper_depth_cm, lower_depth_cm). SOTER numbers the horizons of a profile with HONU.

  • observation: one measured (or estimated) value of one property in one horizon. The wide layout has one row per horizon and one group of columns per property; the long layout one row per observation.

  • variable: a soil property with a canonical key (organic_carbon), mapped from the source codes (ORGC, orgc); see soil_variables().

The ids (feature_id, profile_id, component_id, horizon_id) are the canonical ids of the hub (UUIDs), the same in every read; the source identifiers are kept in the source columns.

Codes of SOTER and SOTWIS

  • PRID: profile identifier.

  • HONU: horizon number within a profile.

  • SUID: SOTER unit identifier, the map unit (column suid).

  • TCID: terrain component identifier within a SOTER unit (column tcid).

  • SCID: soil component identifier within a terrain component (the component_rank of a SOTER component; column scid where served).

  • CLAF: the FAO soil unit code of a profile or component (used by the SOTWIS taxotransfer rules, soil_ttr_flags()).

Source support

source_support says what a row stands for in its source, for example observed_point_profile (a profile described and sampled at a point), map_unit_profile_relation (a profile linked to a soil map unit), polygon_estimate (values estimated for a map unit), non_spatial_profile and non_spatial_estimate (without their own geometry).

Views and the first layer

  • view = "raw": the ISRIC data as published, defects included; view = "revised": the documented rules of the server applied, reported by soil_revised_rules() and soil_markings().

  • layer = "first": the first horizon(s) of each profile, with first_layer_status: surface (the one horizon starting at 0), tie (several start at 0, all returned), not_surface (none starts at 0: the first available), depth_missing (SOTER: the surface horizon has no depth); with view = "revised" also surface_within_5cm and first_mineral. profile_markings reports problems of the SOTER horizon sequence. See soil_first_layer().

Markings and flags

Markings are information the source or the server attaches to a value, a layer or a profile (the laboratory method facets, a "guessed value", duplicates in other datasets); flags (value_flags) are warnings such as extreme. Neither changes a value. See soil_markings(), soil_flags().

Rights

soil:summary (catalog and counts), soil:read (data and exports), soil:publish (runs, publications, jobs), soil:admin (variables, products, country refresh); see soil_whoami().
